summary: DirectX-style surface allocation driven by the flags dword a2[6]. A surface-format id is computed from a2[12] via sub_55C650 (with a special case mapping format 7 to 8) and remapped when bit 0x10 is set (21->22, 25->24). Depending on the flag bits 0x1, 0x2, 0x40008, 0x8 and 0x4, the function issues vtable create-surface calls on two sub-objects: the primary at this+0x10FC (vtable+40 / offset 0x28) and the secondary at this+0x1100 (vtable+108 / 0x6C, vtable+100 / 0x64, vtable+80 / 0x50), negotiating width/depth/format from this+0x13E8 / this+0x13EC / this+0x110C and remapping formats via capability flags at this+0x13A8. On success it optionally creates an audio emitter (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(60) + AudioEmitterCreate, stored to a2[1]) and post-processes via sub_53F3F0 / F_2DSurfaceBlitFill. Any vtable call failure on the secondary path formats an error string with aCouldNotAlloca and reports it via sub_53C590(-1, ...), returning -1; otherwise returns 0.

When the flags dword a2[6] has bit 0x10 set, remap format id 21->22 and 25->24 (format aliases), then proceed through the create paths.

Flag bit 0x1: call vtable+108 on the secondary sub-object's vtable (deref of this+0x1100, offset 0x6C) with a2[7], a2[8], format v39 and a2+2; store the result in this+0. A non-zero result goes to the error path.

Flag bit 0x2: if bit 0x40000 is also set, select the width/depth format from this+0x13EC (when a2[9]==32) / this+0x13E8 (when a2[9]==16) / default this+0x110C, then call vtable+40 (offset 0x28) on the primary sub-object's vtable (this+0x10FC), supplying the SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0 result as an argument; store the result in this+0.

Flag bit 0x2 fallback: call vtable+100 (offset 0x64) on the secondary sub-object's vtable with a2[7], a2[8], format v39, 0, 0 and a2+3; store the result in this+0. A non-zero result goes to the error path.

Flag bit 0x40008: first attempt vtable+40 (offset 0x28) on the primary sub-object with the selected format, supplying the SimpleFieldGetter_bfc0 result as an argument; if it succeeds, issue a second vtable+40 call with the swapped this+0x13E8/0x13EC selection.

Format remap after a successful 0x40008 create: when the secondary format v39 is 0, derive a fallback format 23/24/25 (for a2[9]==16) or 20/22/21 (for a2[9]==24/32) from capability bits in *(this+0x13A8); update a2[6] to & 0xFFFBFFF3 | 4 and hand the result to sub_55C450.
On a failing 0x40008 create path, OR 0x80400 into a2[6] and call sub_55C450 with the selected format id.

Flag bit 0x8: call vtable+80 (offset 0x50) on the secondary sub-object's vtable with count a3 (defaulted to 1), v41, format v39, 0 and a2+5; store the result in this+0. On success and without bit 0x40000, fall through to the error path.

Flag bit 0x8 with bits 0x40000 set and 0x200000 clear: allocate 60 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, create an audio emitter via AudioEmitterCreate and store it in a2[1]; then post-process with sub_53F3F0 returning 0 on success, otherwise F_2DSurfaceBlitFill fills the surface.

Flag bit 0x4: call vtable+80 (offset 0x50) on the secondary sub-object's vtable with count a3 (defaulted to 1), 0, format v39, param 2 and a2+4; store the result in this+0; a non-zero result goes to the error path.

Error path: format the string aCouldNotAlloca with the failing result into a 256-byte buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck (with the format "%s - 0x%x") and report it through sub_53C590(-1, buffer), then return -1.
Return -1 on any failed vtable create path, otherwise return 0 after the optional audio-emitter / fill post-processing.
